name: ssp
listed_description: A header only "csv" parser which is fast and versatile with modern C++ api.
reason: Directional claim only. The README says 'fast' and gives internal notes (single-character delimiters are slightly faster than multi-character ones, setup parameters cost a little performance) but no number against any baseline. The repo has no benchmark directory (root: include/ss, script, test, subprojects), the scripts directory holds only CI and single-header generation, the issue tracker is empty, and neither a WebSearch for third-party shootouts nor tc3t/dfglib's csvPerformanceRuns.md (which compares fast-cpp-csv-parser and dfglib only) mentions it. Checked 2026-10-07; last commit 2025-07-05, MIT, 59 stars.
